final_sql:
SELECT COUNT(p.SAFETY_REPORT_ID) AS female_patient_count
FROM ICSR.PATIENT p
WHERE p.PATIENT_SEX_ID = 2

user_query: Show me all pediatric cases (infant, child, adolescent)
final_sql:
SELECT
    p.SAFETY_REPORT_ID,
    p.PATIENT_AGE_GROUP_ID,
    pag.NAME AS AGE_GROUP_NAME,
    p.ONSET_AGE,
    p.PATIENT_SEX_ID,
    p.BIRTH_DATE
FROM ICSR.PATIENT p
JOIN ICSR_LOOKUP.PATIENT_AGE_GROUP pag
    ON p.PATIENT_AGE_GROUP_ID = pag.PATIENT_AGE_GROUP_ID
WHERE p.PATIENT_AGE_GROUP_ID IN (3, 4, 5)

user_query: Show drug counts by role: suspect, concomitant, and interacting
final_sql:
SELECT 
    c.NAME AS drug_role,
    COUNT(d.DRUG_ID) AS drug_count
FROM ICSR.DRUG d
JOIN ICSR_LOOKUP.CHARACTERISATION c ON d.CHARACTERISATION_ID = c.CHARACTERISATION_ID
WHERE d.CHARACTERISATION_ID IN (1, 2, 3)
GROUP BY c.CHARACTERISATION_ID, c.NAME
ORDER BY drug_count DESC
